css: .t9-shell{font:13px/1.4 system-ui,sans-serif;color:#172033;background:#f7f8fb;border:1px solid #dfe3ea;border-radius:16px;padding:15px;box-sizing:border-box;width:100%;max-width:100%;overflow:hidden}.t9-shell header p{margin:0;color:#6c7688;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.09em;font-size:10px}.t9-shell header h2{margin:2px 0 12px;font-size:20px}.t9-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px}.t9-pane{min-width:0;background:white;border:1px solid #dce2eb;border-radius:11px;overflow:hidden}.t9-pane-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;align-items:center;padding:9px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid #e4e8ef;background:#f5f7fa}.t9-pane-head button{appearance:none;border:1px solid #c9d2e0;background:white;border-radius:7px;padding:6px 8px;font:inherit;font-weight:700;color:#27469e;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap}.t9-pane textarea{display:block;width:100%;height:220px;resize:vertical;box-sizing:border-box;border:0;outline:0;padding:10px;background:white;color:#172033;font:11px/1.4 ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Consolas,monospace;overflow:auto}.t9-summary{margin-top:10px;padding:9px 10px;border:1px solid #d2dcef;background:#eef3fb;color:#334a78;border-radius:9px}.t9-summary[data-kind="ok"]{background:#eef9f2;border-color:#cce7d5;color:#27663d}.t9-summary[data-kind="error"]{background:#fff1f1;border-color:#efc5c5;color:#872727}@media(max-width:760px){.t9-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.t9-pane textarea{height:155px}}
js: const exportText=root.querySelector('[data-export-text]');const importText=root.querySelector('[data-import-text]');const summary=root.querySelector('[data-summary]');function makeExport(){const s=api.cloneState();return{schema:'bci.project-export',version:1,timestamp:new Date().toISOString(),projects:s.projects||[],activeProjectId:s.activeProjectId??null,tasks:s.tasks||[],notes:s.notes??{}};}function refreshExport(){exportText.value=JSON.stringify(makeExport(),null,2);}function isObj(v){return v!==null&&typeof v==='object'&&!Array.isArray(v);}function validate(data){const errors=[];if(!isObj(data))return['Root value must be an object.'];if(data.schema!=='bci.project-export')errors.push('schema must be bci.project-export.');if(data.version!==1)errors.push('version must be 1.');if(typeof data.timestamp!=='string'||!Number.isFinite(Date.parse(data.timestamp)))errors.push('timestamp must be a valid date string.');if(!Array.isArray(data.projects))errors.push('projects must be an array.');else if(!data.projects.every(p=>isObj(p)&&typeof p.id==='string'&&p.id.length>0))errors.push('every project must be an object with a non-empty string id.');if(!(data.activeProjectId===null||typeof data.activeProjectId==='string'))errors.push('activeProjectId must be a string or null.');if(!Array.isArray(data.tasks))errors.push('tasks must be an array.');else if(!data.tasks.every(t=>isObj(t)&&typeof t.id==='string'&&typeof t.title==='string'&&typeof t.owner==='string'&&['Todo','Doing','Done'].includes(t.status)&&typeof t.due==='string'))errors.push('every task must contain string id/title/owner/due and a Todo, Doing, or Done status.');if(!(isObj(data.notes)||Array.isArray(data.notes)||typeof data.notes==='string'))errors.push('notes must be an object, array, or string.');if(Array.isArray(data.projects)&&typeof data.activeProjectId==='string'&&!data.projects.some(p=>p.id===data.activeProjectId))errors.push('activeProjectId must identify an imported project.');return errors;}function setSummary(text,kind){summary.textContent=text;summary.dataset.kind=kind||'';}root.querySelector('[data-export]').addEventListener('click',()=>{refreshExport();setSummary('Export refreshed from current shared state.','ok');api.log(9,'Export refreshed');});root.querySelector('[data-import]').addEventListener('click',()=>{let data;try{data=JSON.parse(importText.value);}catch(e){setSummary('Invalid JSON: '+e.message,'error');return;}const errors=validate(data);if(errors.length){setSummary('Import rejected — '+errors.slice(0,3).join(' ')+(errors.length>3?' +'+(errors.length-3)+' more.':''),'error');return;}const current=api.cloneState();api.replaceState({...current,projects:data.projects,activeProjectId:data.activeProjectId,tasks:data.tasks,notes:data.notes});setSummary('Valid import applied: '+data.projects.length+' projects and '+data.tasks.length+' tasks.','ok');refreshExport();api.log(9,'Validated import applied');});refreshExport();const unsubscribe=api.subscribe(refreshExport);root.addEventListener('bci:unmount',unsubscribe,{once:true});
